# AppleTalk is a free anonymous voice chat web application.
# Users can talk to random strangers using voice only — no camera, no signup, no password.

## What is AppleTalk?

AppleTalk (www.appletalk.live) is Bangladesh's free anonymous voice chat app.
It connects you with random strangers via peer-to-peer voice calls.
No camera access, no registration, no real name required.
Users receive a randomly generated alias (e.g. Apple#1234) automatically.

## Key Features

- 100% anonymous voice chat with strangers
- No signup, no email, no password required
- Voice only — no camera, no video
- Interest-based matching (music, gaming, anime, books, travel, etc.)
- Region-based matching across Bangladesh
- Friend system — add anonymous friends and call them directly
- In-call text chat
- Live emoji voice reactions
- Call history
- Completely free forever

## Target Audience

- People in Bangladesh looking to meet strangers anonymously
- English language practice seekers
- People looking for casual anonymous conversation
- Alternative to Omegle (voice-only, no video)

## How It Works

1. Visit appletalk.live and open the app
2. Select your gender once (anonymous alias assigned automatically)
3. Choose your interests for better matching
4. Press the "Tap to Talk" button to enter the matchmaking queue
5. Get matched with a random stranger in under 30 seconds
6. Talk via peer-to-peer voice call (WebRTC — audio never recorded)
7. Add friend or skip to next person

## Privacy

- All calls are peer-to-peer via WebRTC — audio never reaches our servers
- No audio recording, no data selling, no identity exposure
- Device fingerprint used only for persistent anonymous identity

## URLs

- Homepage / Landing page: https://www.appletalk.live/
- App: https://www.appletalk.live/app
